description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing utility, specifically testing configuration parsing for voice and silence timeout settings within an iOS app related to OpenClaw functionality.

classes.name: TalkConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating TalkConfigParsing configuration behavior related to voice providers and silence timeout settings.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Tests that the provider configuration is rejected if normalization is incomplete.

methods.name: ignoresLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Verifies that legacy-specific fields are ignored when the normalized payload does not include resolution.

methods.name: readsConfiguredSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Tests reading of a valid silence timeout value from the configuration.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenMissing
methods.description: Checks that the default silence timeout is used when the configuration is absent.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenInvalid
methods.description: Verifies fallback to default timeout when the configuration value is invalid (e.g., zero).

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenBool
methods.description: Ensures fallback to default timeout when the configuration value is of incorrect type (boolean).
